# Project Guidelines

## New Project Integration

- When creating a new completed project folder in the repository root, also add it to [index.html](/index.html).
- Add the new project's card before every existing project card so it appears first.
- Link the card to `./<ProjectFolder>/index.html`.
- Include the project name and a short category or technology description.
- Include a visual preview or representative thumbnail inside the card.
- Keep the card, preview, and link usable on desktop and mobile sizes.
- Verify that `<ProjectFolder>/index.html` exists and that the homepage link resolves before finishing.
